passage:
A city discovered part of an ancient wall during subway construction. The wall delayed the project, and many commuters complained.
Historians studied it and found that it showed how the old city had protected itself. Engineers changed the subway design slightly and created a small underground display near the station.
When the station opened, commuters could see the wall behind glass while walking to trains.
The delay had been frustrating, but it gave the city a visible link to its older self.
Modern life often moves fast underground. The ancient wall reminded travelers that speed is not the only value beneath a city.
